item.title: 'The Body' Ending Explained: Is Grace Possessed? Netflix Showrunners Talk Season 2
item.description: The Body , Netflix’s new campy-horror TV series , came out this week. But based on a quick social media browse, it might as well have come out months ago. The high school thriller inspired passionate fan debates among viewers and dozens of fan cams dedicated to favorite characters long before a single episode aired. Now that The Body has finally arrived, however, fans are having an entirely different debate that hinges on its wild cliffhanger ending.

item.title: 26 Years Later, Charlie Brown's Final Quote Is Still a Comic Strip Classic
item.description: Charles Schulz's retirement took the world by surprise. Following a period of failing health, Schulz announced on Dec. 14, 1999 that he would end Peanuts . He could no longer see clearly and had been diagnosed with colon cancer. He needed to focus on his health. As a result, Peanuts came to a relatively sudden stop nine weeks later once newspapers had worked through Schulz's existing backlog.

item.title: Magic Is Bringing Back Its Most Controversial Creature Type
item.description: Whether you love or hate Sliver decks in Magic: The Gathering , you should prepare for more Sliver cards to make their way to the game soon. Vice President of Design Aaron Forsythe revealed as much during an in-person interview with Polygon at MagicCon: Atlanta 2026.

item.title: 35 Years Later, Tim Burton’s Greatest Love Story Is Officially on Streaming
item.description: What makes a love story work? For it to transcend, a love story needs more than good-looking actors, chemistry, and romantic dialogue. There’s no set formula, but it must sweep you off your feet. A touch of sadness and wistfulness never hurts.

item.title: 12 Classic Wii Games That Nintendo Should Add to Switch Online
item.description: There’s no shortage of gems in the Wii library, and they didn’t all come from Nintendo itself. Thinking back on some of the games that people missed at the time, it’s easy to argue that Nintendo should add Wii to Switch Online sometime soon, if only so we have another chance to play classic games like the 12 on this list.

item.title: Blade Runner Is Officially Getting The AAA Game Treatment
item.description: Alcon Entertainment, which owns the Blade Runner franchise, confirmed in a recent interview that it has discussed making a AAA game based on the beloved sci-fi series. It's an exciting development for Blade Runner , which has never quite found its footing in gaming despite how influential its visual style and narrative themes have been.

item.title: 8 Iconic Video Game Villains Who Were Actually Right the Whole Time
item.description: Grab your gavel: Court is in session for eight of gaming’s most misunderstood villains. Their charges? One occupied planet, one erased painting, one underwater utopia gone to rot, and a truly staggering body count. But, all that aside, what if these bad guys were actually making a somewhat decent point? Read between the lines of their melodramatic monologues, and perhaps you’ll realize that, say, a centuries-long guilt trip over one catastrophic mistake was in fact understandable rationale for wanting to tear the world down and start over. Or not: You get to decide. Just read each villain’s case file below before reaching a verdict — you might not love where the evidence actually points.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Report Issues with Physical Version Pre-Order Codes
item.description: With its launch less than a week away, players all over the world have started preloading Grand Theft Auto 6 to ensure they're able to play as soon as it drops. Reports from several fans indicate that some code-in-box copies of GTA 6 include a faulty redemption leaflet, preventing buyers from claiming the game.

item.title: 10 Near-Perfect Nintendo Switch Games Nobody Played
item.description: When a system has a library as diverse as the Nintendo Switch, some great games are bound to go unrecognized. There are thousands of physical titles available, and thousands more that never got more than a simple digital release. Not every game is for everyone, though. Many players choose to ignore the digital marketplace altogether because it has become so cluttered. We sometimes overlook even physical releases, now that there are so many of them. That means there are plenty of hidden gems to discover, especially when it comes to the stuff you won’t find on any other console. With that in mind, here are 10 near-perfect Switch games nobody played.
